resetTooltip: Clear audio and sticker and start over
exportTooltip: Preview and copy. Pasting it in the chat sends it as a video (Ctrl+V)
exportDisabledMissingSticker: Paste or drop a sticker first
exportDisabledMissingAudio: Add an audio file or MyInstants link
exportDisabledTrim: Selection must be at most 10.0 s
stickerDropHint: Ctrl+V / Cmd+V, drag & drop, or click (PNG, GIF, WebP)
hoverCropHint: Drag to move · scroll to zoom
downloadFmtMp4: MP4 video (5s or 10s · square · with audio)
audioInputPlaceholder: Paste MyInstants URL or drop MP3/WAV...
copiedReadyToast: Copied to clipboard! Pasting it in the chat (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V) sends it as a video; it does not add it to your stickers.
aboutSubtitle: Local sound sticker creator (5s or 10s). 100% local processing · No accounts or servers.
aboutRights: Sounds from MyInstants remain the property of their owners. StickSound runs 100% locally with no external dependencies. The exported video is at most 5 or 10 seconds, chosen with the button on the audio bar (10 by default).
aboutLicenseLine: Released under the MIT / Apache-2.0 License.
aboutThirdPartySummary: Core components: Tauri, React, fflate, mp4-muxer, webm-muxer (MIT), Rust image/gif/webp/reqwest/serde (MIT / Apache-2.0), zip (MIT), and symphonia (MPL-2.0). See THIRD_PARTY.md in the repository for the full list.
exportSuccessVideo: Video downloaded. WhatsApp does not import it as a sticker. On some Android beta accounts you can try Create sticker and pick this video from the gallery; WhatsApp decides the duration and audio. That beta is not officially documented.
exportSuccessWebp: WebP sticker downloaded. It is a still image, without audio.
exportSuccessBundle: Bundle saved. Note: it contains image and sound as separate files; WhatsApp may treat the image as a normal sticker.
shareReadyToast: Video ready. Tap "Share" to send it to WhatsApp or save it to Photos.
videoSilentToast: This video has no sound (or it could not be read). You can pick a sound with the audio button.
browseError: Could not load MyInstants. Check your connection.
gifError: Could not load Tenor. Check your connection.
recordError: Could not use the microphone. Check the browser permission.
